_notes: V3 (config_version 2): permanent rewarded song unlocks, HOME PLAY-counter interstitial (the only interstitial trigger), AdMob App Open, adaptive AdMob banner on HOME/SHOP, immediate Continue popup with several voluntary continues per attempt, 3-2-1-GO countdown (never under 3 s).

RUNTIME (applied by the game from this file, no rebuild): ads_enabled, test_mode, max_ad_content_rating, refresh_minutes, rewarded.*, providers.admob.enabled, providers.admob.rewarded_id / rewarded_fallback_ids / interstitial_id / banner_id, placements.*.
AdMob unit IDs are accepted only from the same AdMob account as the app ID built into the APK; production units are used only by a build with production_ready = true.
BUILD-TIME: providers.admob.app_id (packaged in the Android manifest). Shown here for reference; changing it here has no effect.

DASHBOARD ONLY: every 'admob_dashboard' block (Liftoff, Meta, Mintegral: AdMob mediation groups) and 'levelplay_dashboard' block (Unity Ads: LevelPlay SDK Networks; ironSource Ads needs no extra IDs, it uses the LevelPlay app key). The SDKs read these IDs from their mediation dashboards, never from the app. References only; the game records 'enabled' for diagnostics.

NEVER put reporting secrets in this public file (Liftoff Reporting API Key, Unity Ads API Key / Organization core ID, ironSource Secret Key / Refresh Token, Mintegral Skey / Secret). Enter them only in the mediation dashboards.

PLATFORM ORDER: mediation.primary is always AdMob (AdMob, Liftoff, Meta, Mintegral). mediation.secondary 'levelplay' (ironSource Ads + Unity Ads) is asked only when AdMob has no ad ready. It stays 'none' here until LevelPlay has passed a real Android device test with test ads.

LEVELPLAY: app_key is initialization-time (read once per app start; a change applies from the next start); rewarded_ad_unit_id / interstitial_ad_unit_id are runtime (the ad object is recreated at the next load). ironSource Ads and Unity Ads are configured only in the LevelPlay dashboard.
Raise config_version on every edit: the game ignores a file older than the one it already has.

SAFETY LIMITS IN CODE (a file can't lift them): countdown 3-5 s; revive max_per_attempt 0-10; interstitial interval 1-20, cooldown >= 30 s, min gap after any full-screen ad 30-600 s; app open cooldown >= 60 s; first song always free; no banner and no ad during a song or countdown.
